# Interference Zone and Collision Protection FAQ

<!-- This page is auto-generated from the field FAQ knowledge base, 2 entries -->

## Q1: Which coordinate system is the manually filled interference zone value in, and how many methods are there?

1. In Cartesian coordinates, the machine coordinates in the monitor can be viewed for specific data. 2. There are two setting methods: "manual filling" and "calibration".

## Q2: Networked stamping: when this machine returns to the material pick-up standby point after picking up material, an error stops it inside the press, causing a collision

The program logic sends the pick-up complete signal while moving to the pick-up standby point; the stop caused by the error does not interrupt the front machine controlling placement stamping. The interference zone function should be enabled to make judgments
